one_liner: Juan Soto worked pitchers harder than anyone in this group in 2025: 2,940 pitches seen, the largest pitch diet in this twelve-hitter set.
three_things: Elite contact underneath the patience: .429 estimated wOBA on contact, behind only Aaron Judge in this group.
Hard contact on average -- 87.3 mph mean exit velocity over 738 batted balls.
Four-seam fastballs were only 25.2% of what he saw, and 49.7% of pitches landed in the rulebook zone.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). Contact numbers are over the 738 batted balls only, not all 2,940 pitches, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model -- it says nothing about walks or strikeouts, which are the core of Soto's game. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull, so no whiff or chase rate here. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Largest/behind only Judge' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
